name: Molmo2-ER
license_note: Apache 2.0. trust_remote_code executes the checkpoint's modeling code.
notes: Embodied-reasoning VLM that MolmoAct2 pretraining starts from. Molmo2 architecture: Qwen3-4B geometry (36 layers, hidden 2560, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads) plus a SigLIP2 vision encoder at 378px. The original Molmo-7B, Molmo2-8B, and a bare Qwen3-4B are different models. Molmo2-ER itself was trained from the Molmo2-4B archive.
